title: ALMA 0.5 kpc Resolution Spatially Resolved Investigations of Nuclear Dense Molecular Gas Properties in Nearby Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxies Based on HCN and HCO<SUP>+</SUP> Three Transition Line Data
question: What are the physical and chemical properties of nuclear dense molecular gas in nearby ULIRGs at <=0.5 kpc resolution, and how do they spatially vary between the innermost (<=0.5 kpc) and outer nuclear (0.5-2 kpc) regions?

evidence.quote: Col.(5)–(8): f$_{12}$, f$_{25}$, f$_{60}$, and f$_{100}$ are *IRAS* fluxes at 12 $\mu$m, 25 $\mu$m, 60 $\mu$m, and 100 $\mu$m, respectively, taken from (cite: kim98) or (cite: san03) or the IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC).

external_data.citation: (cite: kim98), (cite: san03), IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC)

what.value: Redshifts from ALMA dense molecular line data

evidence.quote: Col.(2): Redshift adopted from ALMA dense molecular line data (cite: ima16b), which are slightly different from optically derived ones (cite: kim98) in some cases.
Col.(10): Optical spectroscopic classification by (cite: vei99) or (cite: vei95).

what.value: Infrared spectroscopically estimated bolometric contribution of AGN

evidence.quote: Col.(11): Infrared spectroscopically estimated bolometric contribution of AGN in % by (cite: nar10) for all ULIRGs and by (cite: per15) for the LIRG NGC 1614.

what.value: Herschel photometric data at 250, 350, and 500 um for four ULIRGs

evidence.quote: For four ULIRGs, photometric data at 250 $\mu$m, 350 $\mu$m, and 500 $\mu$m, taken with the Herschel Space Observatory, are available (cite: cle18).

what.value: ALMA Cycle 5 HCN and HCO+ J=3-2 data of ULIRGs

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present our new $\lesssim$0.2$''$ ($\lesssim$0.5 kpc)-resolution HCN and HCO$^{+}$ J=2–1 and J=4–3 observational results of nearby ULIRGs already observed at J=3–2 with similarly high spatial resolution by (cite: ima19).

what.value: ALMA J=2-1, J=3-2, and J=4-3 data of HCN and HCO+ for NGC 1614

evidence.quote: NGC 1614 (a starburst-dominated luminous infrared galaxy \[LIRG\] with L$_{\rm IR}$ = 10$^{11.7}$L$_{\odot}$ at $z =$ 0.016) is added for comparison, because J=2–1, J=3–2, and J=4–3 data of HCN and HCO$^{+}$ with $\lesssim$0.5 kpc resolution are available (cite: ima13a; ima16b; ima22).

recipe.method: Subtract continuum using uvcontsub on line-free channels, then image continuum and line cubes with tclean using Briggs weighting
key_parameters: robust = 0.5, gain = 0.1, velocity resolution ~20 km s^-1, pixel scale = 0.02'' pixel^-1

recipe.goal: Create moment 0 and moment 1 maps at original beam resolution
recipe.method: Integrate channels showing significant line signals relative to continuum level to produce integrated intensity (moment 0) and intensity-weighted mean velocity (moment 1) maps

recipe.goal: Beam matching to fixed physical scales and spectral extraction
recipe.method: Smooth cleaned images to circular beams of 0.5 kpc, 1 kpc, and 2 kpc diameter using imsmooth, extract spectra at continuum peak position, and subtract circular beam spectra to get 0.5-1 kpc and 1-2 kpc annular spectra
key_parameters: beam diameters = 0.5 kpc, 1 kpc, 2 kpc; annular regions = 0.5-1 kpc, 1-2 kpc
assumptions: H_0 = 71 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_M = 0.27, Omega_Lambda = 0.73

recipe.goal: Measure velocity-integrated line fluxes and line ratios via Gaussian fitting
recipe.method: Fit single or double Gaussian profiles to detected HCN, HCO+, CS, and HC3N lines in extracted spectra and compute HCN/HCO+, high-J/low-J, HCN/CS, and HC3N/HCN flux ratios in Jy km s^-1

recipe.goal: Non-LTE RADEX modeling with Levenberg-Marquardt fitting (fixed column density and abundance ratio)
recipe.method: Fit observed high-J to low-J flux ratios of HCN and HCO+ with RADEX models using Levenberg-Marquardt least-squares fitting, both without flux scaling and with two-stage L-BFGS-B + Levenberg-Marquardt flux scaling within calibration uncertainties
key_parameters: log n_H2 grid from 2 to 6, log T_kin grid from 1 to 3; flux scaling max 5% for J=2-1 and 10% for J=3-2 and J=4-3
assumptions: One-zone uniform sphere, T_bg = 2.73 K, collisions with only H2, line width = 500 km s^-1, N_HCO+ = 1 x 10^16 cm^-2, [HCN]/[HCO+] = 3

recipe.goal: Bayesian MCMC analysis of all line ratios simultaneously
recipe.method: Simultaneously fit HCN-to-HCO+ flux ratios (J=2-1, 3-2, 4-3) and HCO+ high-J to low-J flux ratios (J=3-2/2-1, 4-3/2-1) with RADEX using MCMC sampling in emcee with all parameters free
key_parameters: 100 walkers, 100*tau steps, burn-in = 5*tau steps, thinned by 0.5*tau steps, 19,000 posterior samples
assumptions: One-zone uniform sphere, T_bg = 2.73 K, collisions with H2 only, line width = 500 km s^-1

answer_key.quantity: HCN J=4-3 / CS J=7-6 flux ratio (IRAS 16090-0139, <=0.5 kpc)
HC3N J=18-17 / HCN J=2-1 flux ratio (IRAS 00091-0738, <=0.5 kpc)

not_stated_but_needed: tclean stopping threshold, niter, deconvolver, and masking strategy
Polynomial order (fitorder) used in CASA uvcontsub
Exact velocity/channel integration ranges used to construct the moment 0 and moment 1 maps
Exact ALMA project codes for the archival NGC 1614 datasets (Cycle 0, Cycle 2, Cycle 5)
missing_for_reproduction: tclean stopping criteria (niter, threshold) and masking details
Custom Python scripts driving pyradex, lmfit (two-stage L-BFGS-B + Levenberg-Marquardt), and emcee
Exact ALMA project codes for the NGC 1614 Cycle 0, 2, and 5 archival datasets
score_reason: High reproducibility: pipeline-calibrated ALMA data, exact CASA version, continuum frequency ranges, pixel scales, smoothing scales, Gaussian fits, and intermediate line fluxes/ratios are all explicitly tabulated, and RADEX/MCMC priors and settings are thoroughly specified.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA datasets, well-documented imaging/smoothing recipe, complete intermediate tables of line fluxes and ratios, and open-source modeling tools (pyradex, lmfit, emcee) with explicit parameter bounds and numeric answer keys.
